# Gartner Acquires Software Advice

Summary

Vista Point Advisors is pleased to announce the acquisition of Software Advice by Gartner (NYSE: IT). Vista Point Advisors acted as the exclusive financial advisor to Software Advice.

[Press Release](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20140311005585/en/Gartner-Acquires-Software-Advice)

**About Software Advice:**

[Software Advice](https://www.softwareadvice.com/) is the leading online service for businesses navigating the software selection process. Advisors provide free, personalized software recommendations, helping companies of all sizes find products that meet their business needs. Software Advice also features objective research by industry experts and reviews from validated users, saving buyers time and resources.

**About Gartner:**

[Gartner](https://www.gartner.com/en) (NYSE: IT) is the world's leading information technology research and advisory company.
Gartner provides independent and objective research and analysis on the information technology, computer hardware, software, communications, and related technology industries worldwide. Founded in 1979, Gartner is headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, and has 6,600 associates, including 1,500 research analysts and consultants, and clients in 85 countries.

**About Vista Point Advisors:**

Vista Point Advisors is a boutique investment bank that focuses on advising middle-market companies in the Software, Mobile, and Internet / Digital Media industries. Our strategy is to partner with growing and profitable businesses that are interested in understanding their options in the marketplace. We focus exclusively on sell-side M&A and capital raising transactions. Vista Point Advisors is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

Modified on Mar 11, 2015

Today, that approach enters its most significant chapter yet. I’m thrilled to share that G2 has formally agreed to acquire the software discovery and recommendation platforms Capterra, Software Advice, and GetApp from Gartner. This is a transformational moment for G2, and, more importantly, the global B2B software industry. By bringing together four of the leading software discovery platforms, we are creating the definitive system of record for B2B software in the age of AI. ## Why is this acquisition important? The software buying experience today is often fragmented and overwhelming. Buyers are caught in a sea of noise, while vendors struggle to find high-intent signals across disconnected platforms. In the age of AI, this friction is no longer sustainable. By combining our complementary global audiences and datasets, we are building a future-ready foundation for the entire software ecosystem.
Together, this network of marketplaces will reach 200+ million annual software buyers and boast nearly 6 million verified customer reviews. This unprecedented scale allows us to provide the most trusted data foundation to power smarter, faster purchasing decisions for both humans and AI. ## What this means for the B2B software ecosystem While I am excited for G2’s continued growth, this acquisition is about making the marketplace work better for everyone. * **For Buyers** : We are removing noise and providing you with more helpful information during your purchasing process. With access to 6 million verified reviews in one place, you can trust G2 to be your ultimate guide to B2B software. And, through [G2.ai](https://ai.g2.com/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=galaxy&utm_content=none_&utm_term=none) , we’ll be able to deliver AI-driven recommendations at a scale that was previously impossible.
* **For Software Vendors** : We are simplifying your path to growth.
Our vision is to provide sellers with a more streamlined way to reach the world’s largest audience of in-market buyers through an aligned taxonomy. This deeper dataset will deliver up to 3x more [Buyer Intent](https://sell.g2.com/data?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=galaxy&utm_content=none_&utm_term=none) signals, powering new pay-per-lead offerings that convert interest into sales-ready leads for your pipeline.
* **For Partners and Investors** : We are providing the data infrastructure for the AI era. As search shifts from traditional SEO to [Answer Engine Optimization](https://www.g2.com/categories/answer-engine-optimization-aeo?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=galaxy&utm_content=none_&utm_term=none) (AEO), this combined dataset becomes the primary source of truth for the LLMs and agents that will inform the next decade of GTM strategies.
### Reaching our peak I’m truly excited for all the ways this acquisition will help G2 better serve the global software industry. More trusted data means we can provide much better buying recommendations, richer buyer intent signals and insights than ever before, and more AI visibility (AEO) to efficiently connect software buyers and sellers. The software industry is moving at the speed of AI, and we’re excited to fuel that AI-powered growth with verified data. I want to thank the G2 team for the passion and dedication they’ve shown every day because their work has made this milestone possible. I’d also like to extend a warm welcome to our new colleagues from Capterra, Software Advice, and GetApp. Welcome to G2!

[G2](https://www.g2.com/) recently agreed to acquire the software discovery and recommendation platforms Capterra, Software Advice, and GetApp from [Gartner](https://www.gartner.com/en) .

The acquisition brings together four of the top B2B software review platforms with complementary global audiences and datasets to power software buying and selling in the age of artificial intelligence (AI).
The combined insights will assist software discovery, evaluation, and purchasing— delivering better outcomes for buyers, stronger growth for vendors, and a future-ready foundation for the global software ecosystem.

The addition of richer datasets from Capterra, Software Advice, and GetApp will enrich integrations, improve targeting, and decision-making, said G2 officials. This will allow consultants and investors will strengthen their market analysis, research, and growth strategies with verified, data-backed insights.

### **‘Transformational Moment’**

With this acquisition, Godard Abel, CEO and co-founder of G2, said the company is uniquely positioned to lead the evolving landscape of AI-driven search, delivering accelerated value to both buyers and sellers of software

“This acquisition represents a transformational moment for G2 and, more importantly, the global B2B software industry,” said Abel in a statement.
“By integrating the verified reviews, insights, and audiences from Capterra, Software Advice, and GetApp, we’re building the trusted data foundation for buyers and sellers of software for the age of AI.”

### **Capturing Buyers**

With the acquisition, G2 will be better able to serve the software ecosystem. With expanded reach and web traffic, the company builds on its proven answer and search engine optimization (AEO and SEO) playbook to boost customer visibility across traditional and AI-driven search.

A more mature digital advertising infrastructure will strengthen G2’s Ads business, helping vendors capture more in-market buyers at the moment of decision. The company will incorporate data and offerings from into its platform that will:

* Provide 6 million verified, trusted customer reviews for buying insights
* Reach 200+ million annual software buyers globally across our properties
* Serve 10,000+ software vendors globally with powerful marketing solutions
* Span 2,000+ software and service categories for a robust, market-leading taxonomy
* Offer first-and second-party [Buyer Intent](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4603414-1&h=1046842368&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsell.g2.com%2Fdata%3Futm_source%3Dnewswire%26utm_medium%3Dpr%26utm_campaign%3Dgalaxy&a=Buyer+Intent) data at an expanded scale

With a deeper, unified data set, G2 will deliver up to three times more Buyer Intent signals and enable a new pay-per-lead offering that converts intent into high-quality, sales-ready leads at a global scale. The transaction is expected to close in Q1 2026, subject to customary closing conditions.
